dish.title: Steak au Poivre with Crispy Smashed Potatoes
dish.description: Strip steaks pressed into cracked black peppercorns, seared to a dark crust, and finished with a classic French pan sauce of shallot, brandy, Dijon, and cream. Served with baby potatoes boiled, smashed, and oven-roasted until crispy.

recipe_version.title: Steak au Poivre with Crispy Smashed Potatoes
recipe_version.description: Strip steaks pressed into cracked black peppercorns, seared to a dark crust, and finished with a classic French pan sauce of shallot, brandy, Dijon, and cream. Served with baby potatoes boiled, smashed, and oven-roasted until crispy.

ingredients.name: New York strip steaks
ingredients.preparation: patted dry, at room temperature 20 minutes

ingredients.name: Diamond Crystal kosher salt
ingredients.note: Divided: 11 g on the steaks (about 2.8 g each), 24 g in 10 cups potato water (about 1% by weight), 2 g on the smashed potatoes, 1 g in the sauce. 38 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt (13.5 tsp). The same weight is 8 tsp Morton coarse kosher salt or 6.25 tsp table salt. UC ANR publication 390575 (November 2023): Diamond Crystal kosher salt 2.8 g per teaspoon, Morton coarse kosher salt 4.8 g per teaspoon, table salt 6 g per teaspoon.

steps.title: Preheat and prep
steps.body: Turn the oven on to 450 F to preheat. Put the potatoes in a 4-quart pot with 10 cups cold water and 24 g of the Diamond Crystal kosher salt (about 1% by weight) over high heat. Crack the peppercorns coarsely. Season the steaks with 11 g of the Diamond Crystal kosher salt and press the cracked pepper into both sides. Mince the shallot and snip the chives.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.body: Bring the 10 cups of salted water to a boil and cook the potatoes until a knife slides in, about 18 minutes. Drain and let them steam dry 2 minutes.

steps.title: Smash
steps.body: Spread the potatoes on the sheet pan, press each one flat to about 1/2 inch, drizzle with the olive oil, and sprinkle with 2 g of the Diamond Crystal kosher salt.

steps.title: Roast the potatoes
steps.body: Roast in the preheated 450 F oven until deep golden and crispy at the edges, 22 minutes.

steps.title: Sear the steaks
steps.body: With 12 minutes left on the potatoes, heat the oil in the cast-iron skillet over high until smoking. Sear the steaks, turning as needed, until the center of each steak is 145 F. Move them to a plate and rest 3 minutes. A pinker center is a personal texture preference and is not the instruction in this recipe. Runs inside the potato roast (overlap stated).

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.body: Pour off all but a thin film of fat and lower the heat to medium. Add the butter and shallot and cook 1 minute. Take the pan off the heat, add the brandy, return it to the heat, and simmer until almost gone, about 1 minute. Whisk in the cream, the Dijon, and the remaining 1 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt. Simmer until the sauce coats a spoon, 2 to 3 minutes, adding the steak juices. Taste the sauce and add salt only if it still tastes flat. Spoon it over the steaks and serve with the potatoes and chives.
